blocks.text: Persons with disabilities (PWDs) are often faced with societal and physical barriers that prevent them from fully reaching their ambitions, leaving them stuck and unable to fulfill their dreams. In the case of Alvin Cardinez, a PWD student who was diagnosed with a rare autoimmune disease, he proved to everyone and himself that his disability, despite all the setbacks it brought to his life, did not deter him from achieving his lifelong dreams and succeeding in graduating with high honors from his chosen university – the Polytechnic University of the Philippines (PUP).
